name: Marketplace Tag
description: Generic free-text label row, reused as the child table behind Marketplace Profile.specialties, Marketplace Service.badges, Marketplace Service.features, and Marketplace Project.required_skills. These are rendered as plain tag chips in the current WordPress templates (array_slice($acc['specialties'],0,4) etc.) with no controlled vocabulary or cross-entity lookup today, so one reusable free-text child doctype is correct instead of four near-identical ones or a premature taxonomy Link.
